name: 2018 equity drawdown (IL&FS period)
description: Replay of the Aug-Oct 2018 Nifty 50 drawdown, which covers the IL&FS defaults and the DHFL share crash. An equity drawdown window, not a credit stress test for our debt funds.
rationale: Peak-to-trough of Nifty 50 closes in 2018 in our cache: 11,738.50 on 2018-08-28 to 10,030.00 on 2018-10-26 (-14.55%), 39 sessions. The window contains the IL&FS group defaults of Sep 2018, the DHFL share crash of 21 Sep 2018 and the government's supersession of the IL&FS board on 1 Oct 2018.
caveats: The window also contains a weak rupee, high crude oil prices and rising US yields; it does not isolate the IL&FS event.

The replay shows no credit stress for our debt funds (ABSL Corporate Bond, SBI Gilt and Axis Liquid each gain about 1% over the window): none of them held IL&FS or DHFL paper, and a universe of popular surviving funds excludes the schemes that did (selection/survivorship bias, see docs/data.md). Use the hypothetical credit_event scenario for a credit shock.
